write_up: This is a strong pharmacy technician resume! Your move from retail pharmacy to inpatient sterile compounding is easy to follow, and your recent work gives a recruiter both the setting and the volume.

The dispensing cabinet line is a great model: it names the work, the six nursing units and the change in stockout reports. Your California license and sterile compounding certification are also easy to find.

A few earlier lines could say more about what you handled, especially prescription verification and immunization scheduling. Your resume is unlikely to be the main thing holding you back; how competitive a particular job is will matter too.
